summary_en: NSSK-EPSILON1 initiated a tender offer for all ordinary shares of Broadmedia Corporation (Code: 4347) listed on TSE Standard Market on October 29, 2026, to take the company private. The bidder has secured commitment from AVI-affiliated funds holding 2,851,053 shares (40.00% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) to tender into the offer.
title_en: Notice Regarding Commencement of Tender Offer for Shares of Broadmedia Corporation (Securities Code: 4347) by NSSK-EPSILON1 Inc.
translation_en_brief:
NSSK-EPSILON1 Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of NSSK-EPSILON2 Inc. (which is controlled by NSSK and its investment funds), commenced a tender offer on October 29, 2026, for all ordinary shares of Broadmedia Corporation (listed on TSE Standard Market under Code 4347) to take the company private. The tender offer excludes treasury shares held by Broadmedia and restricted shares subject to lock-up periods held by certain directors and subsidiary directors.

The bidder has secured a commitment from AVI Japan Opportunity Trust Plc, AVI Japanese Special Situations Fund, and one additional investment fund managed by Asset Value Investors Limited to tender all shares they own—2,851,053 shares representing 40.00% of issued shares excluding treasury stock (calculated as 2,851,053 divided by 7,127,029 shares, which is the total issued shares of 7,500,000 minus treasury shares of 372,971).

As of the announcement date, neither the bidder, its parent company, the NSSK funds, nor NSSK itself held any shares in Broadmedia. The tender offer represents part of a series of transactions to privatize the company's shares and remove it from public listing.
